content:
Although widespread reports that the iPhone 18 Pro will start at US$1,399 may be exaggerated, a significant price hike for this year's new models is almost a certainty.

Apple has paved the way for the impending price shock with its new "Apple Upgrade" programme, and now T-Mobile has responded with a brand-new 3-year instalment plan…

Back in June this year, Apple raised prices across most of its product lines in response to a sharp increase in memory costs. Existing iPhone models were not affected, but it is almost certain that the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will be priced higher than last year's previous generation.

The Apple Upgrade leasing programme allows users to get their hands on various products, including the iPhone, at a lower monthly fee. However, the biggest catch is that users will not own the product after all instalments are paid. Many consumers may ultimately find themselves trapped in an endless cycle of Apple Upgrade leasing.

T-Mobile will launch a brand-new payment plan tomorrow, allowing customers to spread the cost of their iPhone and all associated fees over three years instead of two. The plan, called EIP Flex 36, will be launched with 0% interest and zero down payment, according to the company.

It is worth noting two additional conditions: the zero down payment and 0% interest only apply to customers with good credit ratings. The fine print states that some customers may face an APR of up to 24%. However, if you qualify and plan to keep using the next iPhone for the next three years or longer, this could still be a fairly attractive option.
